description: Make an HTTP request (GET, POST, etc.) to any API or website. If the endpoint returns an HTTP 402 Payment Required challenge, A-Pay automatically signs the cryptographic payment authorization within your budget limits and unlocks the data in <25ms.

headers.description: Optional additional HTTP request headers as key-value pairs (e.g. {"Accept": "application/json", "User-Agent": "APayAgent/1.0"}).

json_body.description: Optional JSON payload object for POST or PUT requests (e.g. {"query": "ETH-USD", "limit": 10}).

method.description: HTTP request method to execute against the target URL (default: "GET"). Allowed values: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE.

url.description: Target endpoint URL to fetch or query with HTTP 402 payment support (e.g. "https://api.example.com/v1/market-data" or "https://apayprotocol.org/api/ping").

name: apay_request
